query:
SELECT
            actors.id AS actor_id,
            (
                bans.actor_id IS NOT NULL
                AND (bans.expires_at IS NULL OR bans.expires_at > now())
            ) AS "is_banned!"
        FROM actors
        LEFT JOIN bans ON bans.actor_id = actors.id
        WHERE actors.username = $1 AND actors.deleted_at IS NULL
